wuxia.name: Wuxia
wuxia.tagline: A master of the martial world sizes up your skill
wuxia.speaker: White-Haired Swordsman
wuxia.place: Dueling ground on a misty peak
wuxia.a0.title: Plum Blossom Sword of Mount Hua
wuxia.a0.line1: Your blade goes straight. You don't know how to go around.
wuxia.a0.line2: That stubborn streak will save your life one day.
wuxia.a0.saying1: The plum that won't bend is the last to bloom. A straight blade is the same.
wuxia.a0.saying2: A straight blade gets there in the end, however crooked the road.
wuxia.a1.title: Tai Chi Master of Wudang
wuxia.a1.line1: Push and you don't give. Pull and you don't follow.
wuxia.a1.line2: That kind of patience is rare. Don't rush.
wuxia.a1.saying1: Water picks no fights, yet in the end it cuts through rock.
wuxia.a1.saying2: The soft holds out longest. Whoever holds out longest wins.
wuxia.a2.title: Drifter Like the Wind
wuxia.a2.line1: No sect will ever tie down eyes like those.
wuxia.a2.line2: The road alone suits you better, I'd say.
wuxia.a2.saying1: The wind looks for no place to stay. Wherever it has passed, that is the road.
wuxia.a2.saying2: A blade without a sect travels light. That's why it goes farther.
wuxia.a3.title: Hidden Weapons Expert of the Tang Clan
wuxia.a3.line1: Your head moves before your hands do.
wuxia.a3.line2: It'll be over before they even draw.
wuxia.a3.saying1: The fight is settled in the head before the blade ever lands.
wuxia.a3.saying2: You can block a blade you see. Not a move that's already been read.
wuxia.q1.c1: Draw my sword and walk straight at them
wuxia.q1.c2: Pretend to back off and wait for an opening
wuxia.q1.c3: Take another road. No reason to fight
wuxia.q2: Your master vanished and left one secret manual behind.
wuxia.q2.c1: Compare it with other sects' manuals and find its weak spots
wuxia.q2.c2: Train from page one, every single day
wuxia.q2.c3: Leave it closed until the time is right
wuxia.q3: A quarrel breaks out at the inn.
wuxia.q3.c1: Pay for my drinks and leave quietly
wuxia.q3.c2: Find out who's backing them first
wuxia.q3.c3: Tell them straight to apologize first
wuxia.q4: If you could hold only one weapon, which would it be?
wuxia.q4.c2: An old saber with a chipped edge
wuxia.q4.c3: A dagger hidden in my sleeve
wuxia.q5: Tournament final. Your opponent has hurt his leg.
wuxia.q5.c1: Stay away from the hurt side
wuxia.q5.c2: Take the sure win while I can
wuxia.q5.c3: Forfeit and step down. No fun in a fight like this
wuxia.q6: What name do you want to leave in the martial world?
wuxia.q6.c1: Someone nobody knows, but everyone steps around
wuxia.q6.c2: Someone who stood with the weak
wuxia.q6.c3: Someone no one could read to the end
wuxia.ext.place: Below the mountain, the people who watched you
wuxia.ext1: A murmur rises from below the mountain.
wuxia.ext2: Everyone who saw the duel today will be saying your name for a while.
fantasy.name: Fantasy
fantasy.tagline: The princess finds your place in her palace
fantasy.speaker: The Princess
fantasy.a0.title: Paladin of the Dawn
fantasy.a0.line1: When I stand behind you, I feel safe. I can't explain it.
fantasy.a0.line2: I wish the kingdom had more people like you.
fantasy.a0.saying1: Only those who keep watch through the darkest hour get to greet the dawn.
fantasy.a0.saying2: A shield raised for others is heavy. Still, some people never set it down.
fantasy.a1.title: Archmage Who Reads the Stars
fantasy.a1.line1: Ask you one question and you'd come back with three answers.
fantasy.a1.line2: I'll give you the library key. Just don't stay too late.
fantasy.a1.saying1: The stars don't give answers. They only light the way for those who hold a question long enough.
fantasy.a1.saying2: They say every spell began with a single word: 'why.'
fantasy.a2.title: Shadow Scout
fantasy.a2.line1: I didn't even see you come in. How long have you been there?
fantasy.a2.line2: If the palace ever has a secret, I'll call you first.
fantasy.a2.saying1: Shadows only form beside the light. The quietest one is often the closest.
fantasy.a2.saying2: Where someone passes unnoticed, the most important secrets are left behind.
fantasy.a3.title: Wandering Bard
fantasy.a3.line1: When you speak, everyone turns to look.
fantasy.a3.line2: Please come to the next banquet. Your seat is next to mine.
fantasy.a3.saying1: Even after the song ends, those who heard it keep walking to its beat for a while.
fantasy.a3.saying2: A king's name may be forgotten, but the songs sung at his banquets live on.
fantasy.q1: A dragon appears at the castle gate.
fantasy.q1.c1: Raise my shield and stand at the front
fantasy.q1.c2: Look up its weak spot in the library
fantasy.q2: The king wants to give you a secret mission.
fantasy.q2.c1: Tell no one and leave at night
fantasy.q2.c2: Gather my friends and swear an oath first
fantasy.q2.c3: Read the mission records carefully first
fantasy.q3: At the banquet, you spot a poisoned cup.
fantasy.q3.c1: Stop the song so everyone looks my way
fantasy.q3.c2: Quietly follow whoever set the cup down
fantasy.q3.c3: Knock the cup to the floor
fantasy.q4: If you could keep only one?
fantasy.q5: You're lost in a forest, and night falls.
fantasy.q5.c1: Build a fire and guard the group
fantasy.q5.c2: Climb a tree and look around
fantasy.q5.c3: Find the way by the stars
fantasy.q6: If you became a legend, what would the story be?
fantasy.q6.c1: A song everyone sings along to
fantasy.q6.c2: The one who solved a riddle no one could
fantasy.q6.c3: The one who held the castle to the end
fantasy.ext1: The princess opens the balcony door and calls you over.
fantasy.ext2: I'll put a line about today in the court records.
animal.name: Animals
animal.tagline: The forest owl tells you which animal you're like
animal.speaker: Old Forest Owl
animal.place: Under an old tree in the moonlight
animal.a0.title: Wolf Under the Moon
animal.a0.line1: Your eyes get steadier when you're with others.
animal.a0.saying1: The moon hangs alone, but wolves howl together. That's why the night is less frightening.
animal.a0.saying2: The pack draws its strength from the wolf, and the wolf draws its strength from the pack.
animal.a1.title: Long-Tailed Fox
animal.a1.line1: You see things before everyone else catches on.
animal.a1.line2: Sometimes it's better to keep that cleverness hidden.
animal.a1.saying1: It's the law of the forest, little one: whoever notices first lives the longest.
animal.a1.saying2: Cleverness is quieter than teeth, but it bites deeper.
animal.a2.title: Elephant Who Remembers
animal.a2.line1: You hold on to every little thing.
animal.a2.line2: No one near you ever has to worry about being forgotten.
animal.a2.saying1: Never forgetting means walking a little heavier, you know.
animal.a2.saying2: Grass grows back on the path an elephant walked. That's how memories stay.
animal.a3.title: Wave-Riding Dolphin
animal.a3.line1: The water changes the moment you show up.
animal.a3.line2: A dull forest needs at least one kid like you.
animal.a3.saying1: Fight the waves and you'll tire. Ride them and you'll laugh.
animal.a3.saying2: When the water laughs, the forest laughs along.
animal.q1: Heavy rain falls on the forest.
animal.q1.c1: Count to make sure all my friends are here
animal.q1.c3: Go to a cave no one else knows
animal.q2: An animal you've never seen comes closer.
animal.q2.c1: Play a little trick on it first
animal.q2.c2: Watch from far away for a long time
animal.q2.c3: Stand in front of the pack to meet it
animal.q3: You run into an old friend.
animal.q3.c1: Recall every detail from back then
animal.q3.c2: Walk beside them without a word
animal.q3.c3: Shout out loud, I'm so glad
animal.q4: There's only one bite of food left.
animal.q4.c1: Hide it away where no one sees
animal.q6: What if you had to leave the forest?
animal.q6.c1: Go slow so everyone can keep up
animal.q6.c3: Find the shortcut before I go
animal.ext.place: A lakeshore in the dawn mist
animal.ext1: The owl spreads its wings and leads you to the lake.
animal.ext2: Your reflection looks a little clearer than before.
gem.name: Gems
gem.tagline: The jeweler appraises you like an uncut stone
gem.speaker: The Jeweler
gem.place: A small jewelry shop at the end of an alley
gem.a0.title: Blazing Ruby
gem.a0.line1: This red glow is hard to copy.
gem.a0.line2: Keep it close and everything around it warms up.
gem.a0.saying1: A stone born in fire never loses its red, even once it cools.
gem.a0.saying2: They say a ruby looks even redder in the dark.
gem.a1.title: Deep Sea Sapphire
gem.a1.line1: This stone doesn't show its light right away.
gem.a1.line2: The longer you look, the deeper the color gets. Much like you.
gem.a1.saying1: The deeper the water, the quieter it runs. But it holds everything.
gem.a1.saying2: That blue is a color hurried eyes never see.
gem.a2.title: Forest Emerald
gem.a2.line1: It looks like there's a small garden inside.
gem.a2.line2: Stones like this get better the more they're handled.
gem.a2.saying1: They say no emerald is flawless. Its flaws are called its garden.
gem.a2.saying2: Green is a color that rests the eyes the longer you look at it.
gem.a3.title: Unshakable Diamond
gem.a3.line1: From any angle, the lines hold.
gem.a3.line2: This one won't need a certificate.
gem.a3.saying1: Even the hardest stone began as black carbon. The time it endured became its light.
gem.a3.saying2: They say only a diamond can cut a diamond.
gem.q1: What catches your eye first in the shop window?
gem.q1.c1: Something that burns red in the light
gem.q2: When you pick out a gift, you...
gem.q2.c1: Take my time and picture their face
gem.q2.c2: Buy it the moment I decide
gem.q3: Someone asks you for an awkward favor.
gem.q3.c1: Think it over for a day, then answer
gem.q3.c3: If it's a no, say no
gem.q4: What if someone gave you a scratched ring?
gem.q4.c1: Wear it as is. The scratch is mine too
gem.q4.c3: Quietly take it in for repair
gem.q5: The lights go out in the shop. You...
gem.q5.c3: Wait for my eyes to adjust
gem.q6: What do you want to keep for a long time?
gem.q6.c3: The first award I ever won
gem.ext1: The owner opens the door to the back workshop for you.
gem.ext2: You're the first customer I've ever shown in here.
theory.bigfive.name: Big Five
theory.type16.name: 16 Types
theory.enneagram.name: Enneagram
theory.temperament.name: Four Temperaments
theory.bigfive.O+.label: curious
theory.bigfive.O+.desc: You're someone who reaches for the unfamiliar first.
theory.bigfive.O+.strength: You see possibilities others pass by.
theory.bigfive.O+.weakness: You quickly get bored with familiar tasks.
theory.bigfive.O-.label: keeps to the familiar
theory.bigfive.O-.desc: You're someone who trusts and sticks to proven ways.
theory.bigfive.O-.strength: You get it done without wavering.
theory.bigfive.O-.weakness: You accept new methods too late.
theory.bigfive.C+.label: thorough
theory.bigfive.C+.desc: You're someone who sees what you commit to through to the end.
theory.bigfive.C+.strength: Whatever you take on, you leave no gaps.
theory.bigfive.C+.weakness: You get very uneasy when plans go off track.
theory.bigfive.C-.label: spontaneous
theory.bigfive.C-.desc: You're someone who moves however you feel in the moment.
theory.bigfive.E+.label: energized by people
theory.bigfive.E+.desc: You're someone who gains energy by mixing with people.
theory.bigfive.E+.strength: You get things moving wherever you are.
theory.bigfive.E-.label: recharges alone
theory.bigfive.E-.desc: You're someone who recharges in quiet places.
theory.bigfive.E-.strength: You think deeply and choose your words sparingly.
theory.bigfive.E-.weakness: You share your true feelings too late.
theory.bigfive.A+.label: warm
theory.bigfive.A+.desc: You're someone who chooses staying close over fighting.
theory.bigfive.A+.strength: People feel at ease around you.
theory.bigfive.A+.weakness: You swallow complaints and wear yourself out alone.
theory.bigfive.A-.label: firm
theory.bigfive.A-.desc: You're someone who says no when the answer is no.
theory.bigfive.A-.strength: You don't make compromises that cost you.
theory.bigfive.A-.weakness: People mistake you for being cold.
theory.bigfive.N+.label: sensitive
theory.bigfive.N+.desc: You're someone who tenses up at the slightest sign.
theory.bigfive.N+.strength: You notice danger earlier than others.
theory.bigfive.N+.weakness: Your worries grow bigger than reality.
theory.bigfive.N-.label: calm
theory.bigfive.N-.desc: You're someone who keeps breathing steady even when things shake.
theory.bigfive.N-.strength: Your judgment stays clear in a crisis.
theory.bigfive.N-.weakness: You brush off other people's anxiety too lightly.
theory.type16.ISTJ.label: ISTJ · The Quiet Steward
theory.type16.ISTJ.desc: You're someone who feels at ease only when promises and order are kept.
theory.type16.ISTJ.strength: What you take on is done without fail.
theory.type16.ISTJ.weakness: Sudden changes make you freeze up.
theory.type16.ISFJ.label: ISFJ · The Quiet Guardian
theory.type16.ISFJ.desc: You're someone who looks after others without a word.
theory.type16.ISFJ.strength: You notice even the smallest needs.
theory.type16.ISFJ.weakness: You always put your own share last.
theory.type16.INFJ.label: INFJ · The Deep Foreseer
theory.type16.INFJ.desc: You're someone who reads people's hearts first, then chooses the way.
theory.type16.INFJ.weakness: You reach conclusions alone and wear yourself out.
theory.type16.INTJ.label: INTJ · The Lone Planner
theory.type16.INTJ.desc: You're someone who sets the end first and maps the path backward.
theory.type16.INTJ.weakness: You can't wait for others to catch up.
theory.type16.ISTP.label: ISTP · The Quick-Handed Fixer
theory.type16.ISTP.desc: You're someone who takes things apart and fixes them yourself.
theory.type16.ISTP.strength: You stay calm in a crisis.
theory.type16.ISTP.weakness: You rarely put your feelings into words.
theory.type16.ISFP.label: ISFP · Keeper of Their Own Color
theory.type16.ISFP.desc: You're someone who lives quietly by your own senses.
theory.type16.ISFP.weakness: When conflict arises, you silently step back.
theory.type16.INFP.label: INFP · The Heart-Led Idealist
theory.type16.INFP.desc: You're someone who goes where you feel is right.
theory.type16.INFP.strength: Your sincerity lasts a long time.
theory.type16.INTP.label: INTP · The Relentless Questioner
theory.type16.INTP.desc: You're someone who digs in until you know why.
theory.type16.INTP.weakness: You think so much that you start late.
theory.type16.ESTP.label: ESTP · The First to Jump In
theory.type16.ESTP.desc: You're someone who learns by diving in first.
theory.type16.ESFP.label: ESFP · The One Who Lights Up the Room
theory.type16.ESFP.desc: You're someone who fully enjoys this very moment.
theory.type16.ESFP.strength: You change the mood in no time.
theory.type16.ENFP.label: ENFP · The Spark Carrier
theory.type16.ENFP.desc: You're someone whose heart moves the moment you see a possibility.
theory.type16.ENFP.weakness: You start so many things that the endings blur.
theory.type16.ENTP.label: ENTP · The Game-Flipping Polemicist
theory.type16.ENTP.desc: You're someone who argues against the obvious on purpose.
theory.type16.ENTP.strength: You're good at finding new paths.
theory.type16.ENTP.weakness: Trying to win, you lose people.
theory.type16.ESTJ.label: ESTJ · The Line-Up Chief
theory.type16.ESTJ.desc: You're someone who makes things run the way they were set.
theory.type16.ESTJ.strength: You drive work all the way to the end.
theory.type16.ESTJ.weakness: You see other ways as mere stubbornness.
theory.type16.ESFJ.label: ESFJ · The One Who Looks After Everyone
theory.type16.ESFJ.desc: You're someone who is at ease only when everyone else is.
theory.type16.ESFJ.strength: You bring a group together as one.
theory.type16.ENFJ.label: ENFJ · The One Who Leads People
theory.type16.ENFJ.desc: You're someone who believes in others' potential first.
theory.type16.ENFJ.weakness: You carry others' problems as your own burden.
theory.type16.ENTJ.label: ENTJ · The Course-Setting Conductor
theory.type16.ENTJ.desc: You're someone who sets a goal, then arranges people and time.
theory.type16.ENTJ.strength: Your decisions are quick and bold.
theory.type16.ENTJ.weakness: You count others' feelings as a cost.
theory.enneagram.1.label: Type 1 · The One Who Sets Things Right
theory.enneagram.1.desc: You're someone who believes there's a right way and follows it.
theory.enneagram.1.weakness: You're too strict with yourself and others.
theory.enneagram.2.label: Type 2 · The First to Help
theory.enneagram.2.desc: You're someone who reaches out first when others need it.
theory.enneagram.2.weakness: When nothing comes back, hurt piles up.
theory.enneagram.3.label: Type 3 · The One Who Gets It Done
theory.enneagram.3.desc: You're someone who sets a goal and shows it through results.
theory.enneagram.3.weakness: When you stop, you doubt your own worth.
theory.enneagram.4.label: Type 4 · The One With Their Own Grain
theory.enneagram.4.desc: You're someone who seeks a texture all your own, unlike anyone else.
theory.enneagram.4.strength: Your emotions run deep and rich.
theory.enneagram.4.weakness: You long for what isn't there for too long.
theory.enneagram.5.label: Type 5 · The One Who Knows Ahead
theory.enneagram.5.desc: You're someone who must understand before you move.
theory.enneagram.5.weakness: You withdraw on your own for too long.
theory.enneagram.6.label: Type 6 · The One Who Prepares
theory.enneagram.6.desc: You're someone who first weighs what could go wrong.
theory.enneagram.6.strength: You can be trusted with anything.
theory.enneagram.7.label: Type 7 · The One Who Seeks Joy
theory.enneagram.7.desc: You're someone whose feet head toward the fun first.
theory.enneagram.8.label: Type 8 · The One Who Stands Up
theory.enneagram.8.desc: You're someone who pushes harder when pushed.
theory.enneagram.8.weakness: You force things through and make enemies.
theory.enneagram.9.label: Type 9 · The One Who Keeps the Calm
theory.enneagram.9.desc: You're someone who steps back rather than clash.
theory.enneagram.9.strength: Those around you feel at ease.
theory.enneagram.9.weakness: You let things pass without saying what you want.
theory.temperament.sanguine.label: cheerful
theory.temperament.sanguine.desc: You're someone who is drawn first toward people and fun.
theory.temperament.choleric.label: driven
theory.temperament.choleric.desc: You're someone who stands in front and pushes ahead.
theory.temperament.melancholic.label: meticulous
theory.temperament.melancholic.desc: You're someone who thinks deeply and cares about quality.
theory.temperament.phlegmatic.label: easygoing
theory.temperament.phlegmatic.desc: You're someone who goes at a steady pace without rushing.
theory.temperament.phlegmatic.weakness: You wait even when it's time to move.
theory.type16.E.label: goes toward people (E)
theory.type16.I.label: thinks alone (I)
theory.type16.S.label: sees the facts (S)
theory.type16.N.label: sees hidden possibilities (N)
theory.type16.T.label: weighs things (T)
theory.type16.F.label: reads hearts (F)
theory.type16.J.label: decides ahead (J)
theory.type16.P.label: keeps options open (P)
animal.reveal: You are a lot like the {title}.
